# Key Geographic Concepts

Before we talk too much about the impressive things we can do with geographic data science, we need to cover some fundamentals.

## A Note Before we Proceed

In our other lambda workshop, we teach Discrete Event Simulation (DES)

This is a powerful technique for building models of queues and pathways - like elective waiting list, hospital theatres, emergency departments, and more.


## A Mental Model for DES

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width='50%'}

Discrete Event Simulation is like Lego

We give you a few bricks - the core components of discrete event simulation - and suddenly you can build pretty much anything you can imagine

## {.slide data-menu-title='Our Approach to Geographic Modelling'}

While we can’t teach students to solve **every** geographic problem, we help them

:::{.incremental}
- Fill their toolkit with the core tools they’ll need again and again
    - geographic concepts, map making, travel time matrix generation, automated reporting, web apps
- Add in some fancy tools for certain kinds of problems (location optimization)
- Understand where to go to get a new tool when they need it
    - Or use their other tools to build a super-tool!
:::

## Choropleths

Choropleths tell us things about areas

```{python}
from lokigi.site import SiteProblem

problem = SiteProblem()
problem.add_region_geometry_layer("data/LSOA_Devon_2021_EW_BSC_V4.gpkg", common_col="LSOA21NM")
problem.add_demand("data/demand_MF_50_84.csv",     demand_col="Total",
    location_id_col="LSOA 2021 Name")
problem.add_equity_data(
    "data/devon_imd_2025_2021_LSOAs.csv",
    equity_col="Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Decile (where 1 is most deprived 10% of LSOA",
    common_col="LSOA name (2021)",
    label="Indices of Multiple Deprivation",
    continuous_measure=True,
    reverse=False
    )
```

```{python}
problem_randomised.plot_region_geometry_layer(plot_demand=True, interactive=True)
```


## Tobler's First Law

::: {.value-box}
Everything is related to everything else,
but near things are more related than distant things
:::


## Tobler's First Law in Action

```{python}
from lokigi.site import SiteProblem

problem = SiteProblem()
problem.add_region_geometry_layer("data/LSOA_Devon_2021_EW_BSC_V4.gpkg", common_col="LSOA21NM")
problem.add_demand("data/demand_MF_50_84.csv",     demand_col="Total",
    location_id_col="LSOA 2021 Name")
problem.add_equity_data(
    "data/devon_imd_2025_2021_LSOAs.csv",
    equity_col="Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Decile (where 1 is most deprived 10% of LSOA",
    common_col="LSOA name (2021)",
    label="Indices of Multiple Deprivation",
    continuous_measure=True,
    reverse=False
    )
```

:::{.fragment}

```{python}
problem_randomised = problem.copy()

problem_randomised.equity_data

problem_randomised.equity_data["Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Decile (where 1 is most deprived 10% of LSOA"] = (
    problem_randomised.equity_data["Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Decile (where 1 is most deprived 10% of LSOA"]
    .sample(frac=1, random_state=18)
    .to_numpy()
)

ax = problem_randomised.plot_region_geometry_layer(plot_equity=True, interactive=False)
```

:::
